reka-flash.description: NeuroLink default. Listed as reka-flash in the baseline model table on https://docs.reka.ai/chat/models.md (intro: "Our baseline models always available for public access are:") and named as the model in the code examples on https://docs.reka.ai/chat/overview.md, https://docs.reka.ai/chat/function-calling.md and https://docs.reka.ai/chat/api-reference/create.md (retrieved 2026-09-29). https://docs.reka.ai/pricing.md has a row named "Reka Flash" described as "Fast and cost-efficient model for most tasks" with $0.80 under "Input Tokens (per 1M)" and $2.00 under "Output Tokens (per 1M)"; https://docs.reka.ai/chat/models.md ends with "For full listing of models and pricing, see the Reka API Pricing page". tools is true because https://docs.reka.ai/chat/function-calling.md said "Currently, only Reka Flash supports function calling." on 2026-09-29. That sentence is gone: on 2026-10-17 https://docs.reka.ai/chat/function-calling.md redirects to https://docs.reka.ai/chat/overview.md, and neither it nor the Models table at https://docs.reka.ai/chat/models.md uses the id reka-flash (they name reka-flash-3), so this flag and this entry are not confirmed against the current docs and are kept as they were pending a check with a key. Vision is true: the first curl example on https://docs.reka.ai/overview.md sends an image_url content part to model "reka-flash", and the Quickstart's "First request" example (https://docs.reka.ai/quickstart.md) carries the comment '# or "reka-flash"' beside an image_url request. No context window or maximum output figure is set for this model; models.defaultContextWindow and models.defaultMaxOutputTokens apply.

reka-edge.description: Listed as "reka-edge (or reka-edge-2603)" in the baseline model table on https://docs.reka.ai/chat/models.md and on https://docs.reka.ai/quickstart.md (retrieved 2026-09-29). The Quickstart's "First request" example sends an image_url content part to model "reka-edge", and the example response on https://docs.reka.ai/chat/api-reference/get.md lists the id "reka-edge". https://docs.reka.ai/pricing.md has a row named "Reka Edge" described as "Compact model ideal for on-device execution" with $0.10 under "Input Tokens (per 1M)" and $0.10 under "Output Tokens (per 1M)". tools is true because reka-edge is the alias of reka-edge-2603, which the current docs mark as tool-capable (see the reka-edge-2603 entry); it was false while https://docs.reka.ai/chat/function-calling.md said "Currently, only Reka Flash supports function calling." (retrieved 2026-09-29), a sentence that no longer appears. The Models table at https://docs.reka.ai/chat/models.md (retrieved 2026-10-17) has no row named reka-edge, only reka-edge-2603, so whether the API still serves the bare alias is not confirmed. No context window or maximum output figure is set for this model; models.defaultContextWindow and models.defaultMaxOutputTokens apply.

reka-edge-2603.description: Tools are supported per Reka's current docs (retrieved 2026-10-17). The Models table at https://docs.reka.ai/chat/models.md has the header | Model ID | Context | Input | Tools | Structured outputs | Reasoning | and the row | `reka-edge-2603` | 16k | Text, image, video | Yes | Yes | No |, so the Tools column is Yes. The GET /v1/models example on the same page shows "supported_features": ["tools", "structured_outputs", "streaming"] for reka-edge-2603, and the page says "`GET /v1/models` is the authoritative list". The Tools section of https://docs.reka.ai/chat/overview.md (https://docs.reka.ai/chat/function-calling.md redirects there) says "Models that list `tools` in their `supported_features` accept OpenAI-format `tools` and `tool_choice`." and its example request calls model="reka-edge-2603" with a tools list. This replaces tools: false, which rested on the sentence "Currently, only Reka Flash supports function calling." on https://docs.reka.ai/chat/function-calling.md (retrieved 2026-09-29); that sentence no longer appears. Not wire-verified: no API key was used. Vision is true because the Models table lists "Text, image, video" as the input. Prices are those of the "Reka Edge" row of https://docs.reka.ai/pricing.md (retrieved 2026-09-29) and match the GET /v1/models example's "prompt": "0.0000001" and "completion": "0.0000001" US dollars per token. Earlier evidence (retrieved 2026-09-29): named in the same table row as reka-edge, "reka-edge (or reka-edge-2603)", on https://docs.reka.ai/chat/models.md and https://docs.reka.ai/quickstart.md. No context window or maximum output figure is set for this model; models.defaultContextWindow and models.defaultMaxOutputTokens apply.

reka-flash-3.description: Listed in the Models table at https://docs.reka.ai/chat/models.md (retrieved 2026-10-17) with the row | `reka-flash-3` | 64k | Text | No | Yes | Yes |, so input is text only (vision is false) and the Tools column is No (tools is false), the entry that keeps the per-model withhold path covered. Prices are the "$0.10/M input tokens" and "$0.20/M output tokens" shown on its card at https://developer.reka.ai/models (retrieved 2026-10-17), which the Models page names as the source of current prices. The Models page says 64k for the context, a rounded figure, so no context window or maximum output figure is set for this model; models.defaultContextWindow and models.defaultMaxOutputTokens apply. This is a different model from the reka-flash entry above, whose id no longer appears in the current Models table.

errorRules.message: Reka rejected the API key (HTTP 401; https://docs.reka.ai/errors.md lists 401 as authentication_error with the client action "Ensure that you're using a valid Reka API key"). Check {apiKeyEnvVar}. Get one at {setupUrl}

Reka rate limit (HTTP 429; https://docs.reka.ai/errors.md lists 429 as rate_limit_error with the client action "Wait until your rate limit is restored and retry, or upgrade your API tier for higher limits").

Reka reported an insufficient balance (https://docs.reka.ai/resources/faqs.md: "If your balance hits $0, you'll see P001: Insufficient Balance."). The same page says "Add credits to your account before making requests."
Reka returned HTTP 500 (https://docs.reka.ai/errors.md lists 500 as server_error with the client action "Retry with backoff. If this persists, contact Reka at contact@reka.ai").

instructions: 1. Visit: https://platform.reka.ai/sign-up (the "Start for free" and "Get started" links on https://platform.reka.ai/pricing point to /sign-up). The Quickstart (https://docs.reka.ai/quickstart.md) says "Create a free account on the Reka Platform to access your API key." and the FAQ (https://docs.reka.ai/resources/faqs.md) answers "How do I get an API key?" with "Go to Platform, > API Keys to generate or copy your key."

2. Billing as the vendor states it: https://docs.reka.ai/pricing.md says "Get started with no upfront costs."; the FAQ (https://docs.reka.ai/resources/faqs.md) answers "Do I need to pre-pay?" with "Yes. Add credits to your account before making requests." and says the balance error reads "P001: Insufficient Balance" when the balance hits $0

3. Authentication: the vendor's REST examples send the header X-Api-Key (https://docs.reka.ai/chat/overview.md) and the OpenAPI file https://docs.reka.ai/openapi/api-reference.yaml declares one security scheme, an apiKey in the header X-Api-Key; the OpenAI Python SDK examples pass api_key="YOUR_API_KEY" to the client (https://docs.reka.ai/quickstart.md)
setup.description: Docs-verified only: the vendor's GET https://api.reka.ai/v1/models needs a key (it answers HTTP 401 without one), so the four model ids come from https://docs.reka.ai/chat/models.md (retrieved 2026-09-29 for the first three and 2026-10-17 for reka-flash-3) and the roster has not been checked; the entry is not yet live-verified. Endpoint https://api.reka.ai/v1: the Quickstart (https://docs.reka.ai/quickstart.md) says "our API is fully OpenAI-compatible" and shows the OpenAI Python SDK with base_url "https://api.reka.ai/v1"; https://docs.reka.ai/chat/overview.md shows POST https://api.reka.ai/v1/chat/completions with a messages array and reads the reply from response.choices[0].message.content. Unauthenticated GETs made 2026-09-29: /models answered HTTP 401 with the JSON body {"error":{"message":"Unauthorized","type":"authentication_error","code":null,"param":null}}; /chat/completions answered HTTP 405 with header allow: POST and the body {"detail":"Method Not Allowed"}. No POST request was sent. errorRules carry the statuses https://docs.reka.ai/errors.md lists (401 authentication_error, 429 rate_limit_error, 500 server_error) plus a pattern rule on the FAQ's "P001: Insufficient Balance" text. capabilities.streaming is true because https://docs.reka.ai/chat/overview.md says "The Chat API supports streaming". capabilities.tools is model-dependent because tool support differs per model: the Models table at https://docs.reka.ai/chat/models.md (retrieved 2026-10-17) has a "Tools" column that is Yes for reka-edge-2603 and No for reka-flash-3, and the Tools section of https://docs.reka.ai/chat/overview.md says "Models that list `tools` in their `supported_features` accept OpenAI-format `tools` and `tool_choice`." So the models.catalog entries set tools: true for reka-edge-2603 and its alias reka-edge, and tools: false for reka-flash-3 (see CatalogModelSpec.tools), instead of leaving every model to the provider-level model-dependent default. reka-flash keeps tools: true from the sentence "Currently, only Reka Flash supports function calling." (retrieved 2026-09-29), which the current pages no longer carry; that entry is unconfirmed. capabilities.structuredOutput is false: the ChatRequest on https://docs.reka.ai/chat/api-reference/create.md lists messages, model, frequency_penalty, max_tokens, presence_penalty, seed, stop, stream, temperature, tool_choice, tools, top_k and top_p. capabilities.toolsWithStreaming and capabilities.structuredOutputWithTools are false because no request combining them was sent. capabilities.embeddings and capabilities.thinking are false. models.defaultContextWindow (16384) and models.defaultMaxOutputTokens (4096) are placeholders the vendor does not publish; the Chat API reference describes max_tokens as "limited by the model's context length. Defaults to 1024." Each model's status field holds production, a placeholder for a value the catalog schema requires; it is not a vendor statement. billingPolicy holds free-tier, one of the three values the catalog schema allows (free-tier, free-with-card, no-free-tier). The vendor wording behind it: on https://platform.reka.ai/pricing the Pay as you go tile has a "Start for free" link to /sign-up and the page carries the text "Free credits used"; https://docs.reka.ai/pricing.md says "Get started with no upfront costs."; https://docs.reka.ai/resources/faqs.md answers "Do I need to pre-pay?" with "Yes. Add credits to your account before making requests." apiKeyFormat is null, so NeuroLink's key-format check is not applied.

rosterVerified.method: docs-only — unauthenticated GET https://api.reka.ai/v1/models answers 401 without a key, so model ids are taken from https://docs.reka.ai/chat/models.md (retrieved 2026-09-29); roster not verified

authProbe.method: unauthenticated GET https://api.reka.ai/v1/models with no credentials — HTTP 401, JSON body {"error":{"message":"Unauthorized","type":"authentication_error","code":null,"param":null}}; code records the body's error.type because error.code is null; the same day an unauthenticated GET https://api.reka.ai/v1/chat/completions answered HTTP 405 with header allow: POST and JSON body {"detail":"Method Not Allowed"}; credential-free, no key used

Add credits to your account before making requests."), https://docs.reka.ai/quickstart.md ("Create a free account on the Reka Platform to access your API key."), https://docs.reka.ai/pricing.md ("Get started with no upfront costs.") and https://platform.reka.ai/pricing (a "Start for free" link and the text "Free credits used"); credential-free, no signup performed
